name: general-chrome-console-bridge-v5
description: Background-first, session-aware Chrome console bridge with always-on launchd servers.

scripts.build: npm run build:canary && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:canary: BRIDGE_PORT=4471 BRIDGE_INSTANCE=canary BRIDGE_BROWSER_LABEL='Google Chrome Canary' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_NAME='Chrome Console Bridge v5 (Canary)' DIST_DIR=dist-canary node ./scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:chrome: BRIDGE_PORT=4472 BRIDGE_INSTANCE=chrome BRIDGE_BROWSER_LABEL='Google Chrome' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_NAME='Chrome Console Bridge v5 (Chrome)' DIST_DIR=dist-chrome node ./scripts/build.mjs
